methodology.dsr: AFML p.204 dDSR = PSR[SR*]. AFML p.206: should exceed 0.95 for 5% significance.
methodology.effective_number_of_trials: MLAM SS8.7.1 (p.112): number of ONC clusters found on the (Marcenko-Pastur denoised) edge daily-return correlation matrix. A conservative estimate -- true independent trial count is <= this.
methodology.not_a_gate: This lab is diagnostic only. It does not kill, promote, or reweight edges.
methodology.sr_star: AFML p.204-206 False Strategy theorem SR* = sqrt(V[{SR_n}]) * ((1-gamma)*Z^-1[1-1/K] + gamma*Z^-1[1-1/(K*e)]), de-annualized back to each evaluated target's own frequency (MLAM's Frequency_k* step) before plugging into the PSR formula, so it is directly comparable to that target's own non-annualized SR_hat.
methodology.trials_scope: The 21 currently-deployed edges' own realized daily return streams (Step 06/07 raw_r, core_plus_watchlist) -- a documented lower bound, not the full Gate A-D search history, since Quantara has no queryable historical trial ledger and ordinary assets' killed-edge artifacts were deleted per standard practice. See module docstring.
methodology.variance_across_trials: MLAM SS8.7.2 (p.112-113): each cluster's member returns are pooled, restricted to active (nonzero) days, and annualized via Frequency_k=T_k/Years_k; variance is taken across clusters' annualized Sharpe ratios.
